title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds
reason: SEC custody proposal for advisers and funds, corroborated by two outlets and tied to a named commissioner, is clearly publishable crypto regulatory news, though a proposal rather than a final verdict.

sources.summary: The regulator issued a proposed rule for custody, marking a swan song for its inaugural Crypto Task Force chief, Commissioner Hester Peirce, who exits this week.
SEC proposed a crypto framework for investment advisers & funds, allowing self-custody in some cases & state trust companies as custodians.

title: Hyperliquid Policy Center, Circle press EU on perps and stablecoin reserves in MiCA review
reason: Named major companies (Circle, Hyperliquid) making concrete regulatory filings in the EU MiCA review is clearly publishable crypto-policy news.

sources.summary: Hyperliquid's policy group wants perps under MiFID II, while Circle targets MiCA's bank deposit floor in filings to the European Commission's MiCA review.
